planRationale: A genuine, highly visible product shift landed in the last week that touches more than a billion weekly users and changes the one thing every non-technical person notices first: what an AI answer looks like. The site has nodes on multimodal input and agents but nothing on generative/interactive output, so this fills a real gap. It stays relevant in a month because it's a durable interface direction, not a transient news event, and understanding 'AI that builds a tool for your question' helps readers regardless of which product they use.

findings.claim: Vercel's AI SDK streamUI (AI SDK RSC) listed as an example and described via 'Introducing AI SDK 3.0 with Generative UI support'
findings.issue: Still accurate as an example that exists, but note that Vercel now marks the AI SDK RSC module (which provides streamUI) as experimental and development is paused; for production Vercel recommends AI SDK UI (useChat). The cited AI SDK 3.0 blog is from ~2024, so the 'streamUI' example is somewhat dated relative to the current recommended API, though the content makes no false currency claim about it.

items.note: Upload this single file to content/articles/. The existing indexing.yml workflow rebuilds articles_index.json automatically, and the article becomes visible on /trends within a minute or two.

findings.claim: Google introduced a comparable capability with its Gemini 3 model in late 2025, calling it 'generative UI'... The Gemini app can create what Google calls 'Dynamic View'.
findings.issue: Accurate: Gemini 3 launched November 18, 2025 with 'generative UI' and the Gemini app's 'dynamic view' experiment. Minor caveat worth knowing: Google's dynamic view / visual layout remain experimental and selectively A/B-tested rather than default behavior. The draft does not overclaim universality, so this is informational only and not a problem.
